title: ggchord version roadmap and technical design
text: Goal: group sequences (host/phage, chromosome sets, sample groups) visual separation: larger inter-group gap, group labels optional group colors, without changing layered API. Public API: Layout changes (compute_chord_layout()): seq_order resolved, split ordered sequences groups group vector (length 1 n, named seq_id — reuse process_sequence_param()). Angle allocation: instead one sum(seq_gap), add extra gap seq_group_gap consecutive groups: total_gap_prop = sum(seq_gap) + seq_group_gap * (n_groups - 1). New layout element group_arcs/group_labels: group, label anchor midpoint angle first sequence start last sequence end, radius seqRadius * seq_group_label_radius, rotated like seq_labels_df. Group coloring (optional): seq_group_colors set, add thin “group band” polygon color group labels; Seq ID legend unchanged (new aesthetic collisions — use dedicated internal aesthetic like ribbon zfill, plain text colour). classify_ggchord_layers() / extract_ggchord_layer_data() gain group_label case ggplotly() lazy data see geometry. Faces vs chord semantics: faceting (facet_wrap/facet_grid) breaks single-center coordinate space, recommended chord diagrams. supported alternatives : (1) inter-group gaps + group labels (); (2) multiple chord panels arranged user via gridExtra / patchwork; (3) multi-ring layout (see v0.9.0-D). Tests: grouping changes gap allocation (angles last sequence group k shift group gaps); fingerprints must stay reproducible; group labels render; unknown group names error.
code: # Option 1: group column in seq_data (preferred) seq_data$seq_group <- c("phage", "phage", "host", "host")  ggchord(seq_data, ribbon_data, gene_data) +   geom_seq(     seq_group = NULL,               # column name in seq_data or named vector     seq_group_gap = 0.08,           # extra gap proportion BETWEEN groups     seq_group_labels = TRUE,        # TRUE | FALSE | named character vector     seq_group_label_radius = 1.35,     seq_group_colors = NULL         # named vector by group   )  # Option 2 (helper, returns a re-ordered seq_data with metadata): seq_data2 <- ggchord_group_seq(seq_data, group = "seq_group",                                order = c("host", "phage"))

title: ggchord version roadmap and technical design
text: Auto ring placement: geom_seq(seq_ring = "auto") groups sequences nested rings n large; ring gets seqRadius range. automatic choices must reproducible (seed), explainable (chosen assignment returned get_chord_layout()$rings), overridable (seq_ring = NULL disables; explicit seq_radius/seq_order win). Label avoidance: cap ggchord_repel_labels() iterations, add max_overlaps sampling “hide labels beyond N” strategy huge datasets (already partially present via max_overlaps). Ribbon bundling/aggregation: add geom_ribbon(ribbon_reduce = c("none", "sample", "bundle", "density")). “sample” draws stratified subsample; “bundle” merges nearby ribbons single band (reuse merge_ggchord_ribbons() layout geometry); “density” tints chord interior alignment density. Quality-first (default) vs performance-first (ribbon_reduce = "sample") policies documented. Performance baseline test: ribbon_data 5k rows must build bounded time; layout caching (already p$ggchord$layout) must reused, caches must never leak plots (global mutable state beyond get_chord_layout() inspection cache).

title: ggchord：基于 ggplot2 的多序列弦图可视化工具
text: ggchord 是一个基于 ggplot2 的 R 语言包，采用分层的图形语法将多序列数据绘制为直观的弦图。与“一个大函数”不同，你通过叠加图层来构建图形：ggchord() 负责提供数据与全局选项，每个 geom_* 图层负责绘制一类元素（序列弧线、比对连接带、基因注释、坐标轴、标签）。每个图层都有合理的默认值，因此一行代码即可画出完整的弦图，需要精细控制时也可以分别微调每个图层。 该包是通用的多序列比较工具，可用于序列比较、基因邻域分析、噬菌体-宿主关系、泛基因组区块、共线性分析等——你只需要准备三张规整的数据表。

title: ggchord：基于 ggplot2 的多序列弦图可视化工具
text: 真正的 ggplot2 分层风格：数据与全局选项交给 ggchord()，每个 geom_* 图层管理自己的布局参数。 开箱即用：ggchord(data) + geom_seq() + geom_ribbon() + geom_gene() + geom_axis() 即可得到完整图形。 多序列支持：可同时展示两条、三条、四条或更多序列。 灵活的参数：支持单值、向量、命名向量与列表，可按序列或链方向分别设置。 与 ggplot2 生态无缝衔接：theme()、scale_*()、ggsave()、ggplot_build()、plotly::ggplotly() 均可使用。

what: 2. 在 R 中导入 FASTA / BLAST / GFF3 数据
title: ggchord 中文使用指南
text: 外部命令行工具（BLAST、seqkit 等）通常用于准备数据，但它们产出的文件 也可以直接用包内置的导入助手在 R 中读取，从而把「在 R 外准备数据」与 「在 R 中导入并绘图」两个步骤清晰分开： read_blast() 保留有用的额外列（evalue、bitscore、qcovs、qlen、 slen、sstrand、stitle）；read_gff3() 保留 type、source、 score、phase、attributes；read_fasta_lengths() 可通过 header_delim = "|" 拆分 NCBI 风格标题。
code: library(ggchord)  # FASTA -> seq_data（读取并合并全部示例 FASTA 文件） seq_data <- invisible(read_fasta_lengths(files = "examples/fasta/*.fna"))  # BLAST -outfmt 6/7 表格输出 -> ribbon_data（12 或 17 列自动识别） ribbon_data <- invisible(read_blast(files = "examples/blastn/*.o7"))  # GFF3 -> gene_data（默认取 CDS；anno 从 product/Name/... 属性提取） gene_data <- invisible(read_gff3(files = "examples/gff3/*.gff3"))  ggchord(seq_data, ribbon_data, gene_data) +   geom_seq() + geom_ribbon() + geom_gene()

text: Plot objects now fully self-contained: data parameters stored plot instead package-wide environment. Multiple plots can created built independently session, plots survive saveRDS() / readRDS(). layout now computed ggplot_build() rather custom print() method. result print(), ggsave(), ggplot_build() standard ggplot2 workflows (e.g. plotly::ggplotly()) work directly ggchord plots, rendering longer modifies user’s plot object. New layer geom_seq_label(): places sequence labels midpoint sequence arc control radial offset (seq_label_radius), rotation (seq_label_rotation) font size (seq_label_size). New ribbon color scheme "subject": colors ribbons subject sequence (saccver), complementing existing "query" scheme. layout accessor get_chord_layout() now exported, making computed geometry available custom layers annotations. Themes, scales ggplot2 objects can now added + (e.g. p + theme(legend.position = "bottom")), user-supplied colour/fill scales respected instead overwritten. plotly::ggplotly() now works ggchord plot, including plots combine ribbon gene layers (previously raised scale error). dedicated ggplotly.ggchord() method converts computed geometry plotly-friendly plot restores Seq ID / Strand / Identity legends. ggchord() now warns suspicious input data: reversed --range alignment/gene coordinates, pident outside [0, 100], sequence IDs present seq_data. geom_gene_label_repel() gains gene_label_side = "auto" | "inside" | "outside". "outside", labels sit inside chord (can overlap ribbons) mirrored outside sequence arc, keeping radial distance arc. New gene_label_segment_linetype argument controls leader-line linetype. default "auto" draws solid lines, except labels moved side arc (gene_label_side), drawn dashed. valid ggplot2 linetype (e.g. "dotted" numeric dash pattern) applied leader lines. Elbow leader lines longer force fixed segment lengths: stub scales label’s text width horizontal space available gene label, labels can placed flexibly without degenerate (near-zero) stubs. geom_seq_label() now documents follows intended seq_label_radius semantics: 1 sits arc, > 1 places label outside (away chord center) < 1 inside. Previously multiplier applied opposite direction (default 1.15 put labels inside chord). New geom_seq_label() options: seq_label_orientation = "arc" | "horizontal" (horizontal labels extend away chord center), seq_label_hjust / seq_label_vjust per-sequence justification, check_overlap skip labels overlap. default theme longer draws grid lines (panel.grid blank) legend keys transparent (blend plot background instead fixed white rectangle).
